exam_mode.note: The real NCLEX-RN is adaptive: 85 to 150 items in up to 5 hours.

prompt_template:
@options
Give each question between 4 and 6 options. Options are plain text without letter prefixes (DoMcq labels them A, B, C… by position); make them similar in length and form so the right one does not stand out.
Write the real exam's two kinds of item. Most are multiple choice: exactly 4 options and exactly one correct, so `answer` is a single letter. Some are select all that apply: 5 or 6 options, two or more of them correct and at least one incorrect, and the stem ends "Select all that apply." without ever saying how many are correct; `answer` lists every correct letter in ascending order ("ACE").
Never use these as an option: "all of the above", "none of the above". Avoid "both A and B" style options too.
